big: Nifty MidSmallcap 400 is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

lines: What does the Nifty MidSmallcap 400 track?
The Nifty MidSmallcap 400 Index is designed to reflect the behaviour and performance of the mid and small market capitalisation companies. It holds 401 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.
